subject: Request: Pilot runway uplift after integration backlog
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@fastpay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Morgan Lee <morgan.lee@fastpay.com>
Date: 2026-08-07T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — integration snag and timeline

Hi Hannah,

Quick note from our engineering side — we hit a blocker with the webhook handshake and SAML mapping when trying to integrate the Redwood adapter into our staging environment. The team traced it to a schema mismatch in the third-party connector; they're working on a patch but it pushed us out of the demo window next week.

This pilot is important for our roadmap, but with the delay we won't be able to run the evaluations you asked for. Can FastPay get a short runway uplift (sandbox top-up and a 3-week extension on the pilot window) so we can complete the integration and the planned end-to-end demos?

Attached a trimmed integration log and the failing request/response pair.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Torres
Head of Integrations, FastPay
attachments: integration-log.txt (text), failing-request.json (text)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — integration snag and timeline

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear the schema issue blocked you. We want to keep momentum on this.

Proposal from our side:
- 3-week pilot extension (new end date: 2026-09-01)
- $1,500 sandbox top-up applied immediately so your devs can continue testing without throttling
- A quick joint troubleshooting call (30m) tomorrow to walk the patch plan and confirm rollback steps

Dev, can you confirm the patch ETA and whether any additional infra changes are required on our side? Lauren — I'll need a short approval note to apply the top-up.

Alex — if that works for FastPay I can get the extension and credit applied today and send over a confirmation doc.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-08T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — integration snag and timeline

Quick technical update for the thread (internal):
- Root cause: schema version mismatch between FastPay connector v1.2 and our shim expecting v1.3 (missing optional field causes SAML metadata parse to fail).
- Work required: small compatibility layer in the adapter (about 6–8 hours dev + 1 hour QA). We can patch their staging instance within 24 hours of receiving their test payload variations.
- No infra changes needed on Redwood side; this is a connector compatibility patch only.

I'll join the troubleshooting call and can have a PR ready by Monday EOD PST. I'll attach the summarized trace for reference.

Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Sandbox credit top-up: $1,500 (applied to your FastPay sandbox)
- Support: joint troubleshooting call scheduled for 2026-08-11 at 11:00 AM PDT (invite sent)

I've attached the sandbox-topup-approval.pdf and the updated pilot plan (requirements-v2.pdf) with the new dates. Dev confirms the patch is scoped at 1 day of work and doesn't need infra changes from us.

1) Send the varied test payloads Dev requested before the call.
2) Join the call tomorrow so we can validate the PR in staging together.
3) I'll drop the HubSpot deal note and t&c amendment (link below).
